description:
For Starsector 0.98a | Source Code | Issue Tracker

Requires GraphicsLib 1.10.2+ and Combat Chatter 1.15.0+, LazyLib and MagicLib.

What Does This Do?

Follow a master navigator across the Persean Abyss, retrace the Fourteenth Battlegroup's long journey from their staging ground in FOB Ithaca, and discover what they left behind in the Orion Knot Sector.

Adds Sinni, a master navigator, recruitable officer, and unusually persuasive advocate for taking a very small fleet somewhere very far away.

Her ancestor Helen crossed the Abyss with the withdrawing Fourteenth Battlegroup. The account of that journey survived. Sinni has reconstructed the route in reverse, and she needs your fleet and skills to make it to the other side.

The expedition leads from Waypoint Troy to the Orion Knot, with six remote systems, dangerous currents, abandoned Domain installations, and Forward Operating Base Ithaca, a military macrobase built on a scale the Persean Sector has largely forgotten.

THIS IS A BETA, SO STABILITY WILL BE IN PROGRESS FOR THE NEXT FEW WEEKS

SEND YO CRASH LOGS/MODLIST HERE

What Is in This Mod?

New NPC contact and officer: Sinni, with her own bar introduction, Eventide tea briefing, exploration conversations, Combat Chatter, and ongoing navigation guidance.
New story quest: Adept of the Stars and Waves, an expedition into the Abyss and back through the Fourteenth Battlegroup's history.
New exploration quest: One More Horizon. Travel with Sinni and complete her stellar chart
Expanded Hyperspace Topography: Five additional navigation tiers covering gravity-well slipsurges, improved Running Dark, larger generated currents, reduced storm damage, and Echo Mapping.
New Sector!!!: Welcome to the Orion Knot Sector, gateway to the Domain of Man's Heartland.
Six new systems: The Odyssey Expanse, Avici, Sanzu, Ashen Verge, Last Light, and Devoured Reach.

Installation

Download Chief-Navigator-0.5.1.zip from the link above.
Extract the Chief Navigator folder into Starsector/mods. mod_info.json should be directly inside the Chief Navigator folder.
Install GraphicsLib 1.10.2+, Combat Chatter 1.15.0+, LazyLib, and MagicLib. Enable Chief Navigator and its dependencies in the launcher.
Restart Starsector, then start a new campaign or load an existing one.

FAQ

Is it mid-save compatible?

No, there are some mod incompatibility issues that have to be identified. Add to your midsave files at your own risk.

How do I meet Sinni?

Reach max level of Hyperspace Topography Data, Discover the Onslaught Mk 1, then visit a market bar and look for the note from the woman drinking tea. Accept her proposal, then visit her office on Eventide to hear the expedition briefing and reveal Waypoint Troy.

How difficult is it?

This is an expedition where fleet efficiency, supplies, fuel, navigation, and replacement hulls matter. The entry limit keeps your starting force small, and the later battles expect you to make use of what you find in the Orion Knot. Strong recommendation for being max level, or if you are playing with Second in Command, having a full roster of max level officers.

I'm lost?

Call Sinni through Contacts for the current objective and directions from your present location. Once you reach the Orion Knot, she can also open its dedicated system chart.

Known incompatibilities?

Compatibility with every large mod combination has not been established. If something breaks, please report it here or on GitHub with your mod list, a description of what happened, and the relevant starsector.log.

AI Statement

5.6 and 6.1 Sol was used to help with programming, debugging, and editing. Artwork was made with Codex and Photoshop, and edited Starsector-derived assets. Don't worry, I'm a professional.

10/7/2026 - Version 0.5.1

If you fork or build on the repository, please let me know. I would be interested in seeing what you make.

And as always, thank you for playing.

discordPostHtml:
Adds a new officer, Koyama Sinni, and her Questline to reach the Fourteenth Battlegroup's Lost Inheritance -- the Defense Macrocomplex known as FOB Ithaca. Travel with her with a limited exploration fleet to discover the Orion Knot Sector

Since this is a beta, there are stability issues, so please send me your logs and mod list here:

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FMj7JH217Vb2WL-L4naIxTBOBszPIR7K?dmr=1&ec=wgc-drive-%5Bmodule%5D-goto

**Forum Thread: **
https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=36134.msg531820#msg531820

BETA Release Link:
https://github.com/c4tntnitro-netizen/Chief-Navigator/releases/download/v0.5.1/Chief-Navigator-0.5.1.zip

What this mod contains:

  • ** New NPC: **

Koyama Sinni. Your Chief Navigator.

  • ** New Hyperspace Skills**

Adds 6 more levels of Hyperspace Topography Skills to Learn

  • ** New Questline**

Undergo a great trial to save the Orion Knot Sector. In order to recruit Sinni as an officer and unlock the Orion Knot Sector:

  1. Reach max level of Hyperspace Topography Data
  1. Find the Onslaught Mk 1
  1. Find her drinking tea at a bar.
  • ** New Systems**

Six new handcrafted systems, several with unique environments. Alpha Odyssey, Ashen Verge, Devoured Reach, Sanzu, Avici, Last Light

  • ** New Sector!!!**

The Orion Knot Sector, a mini-sector that stands at the Gateway to the Domain Heartland

IMPORTANT - Not mid-save compatible

  • ** New Bosses**

Three new bosses.

**Requirements: **

GraphicsLib 1.10.2 or newer
Combat Chatter 1.15.0 or newer
Starsector 0.98a

Recent fixes

Updated the wall module and drifitng wall sprites to more high quality upscales.

Fixed a crash caused by a boss' custom weapons having their description be malformed.

Implemented a possible fix(?) for heavenly strike not spawning in. Current theory is the breach defense gate does not spawn during Labor V.
